title: history being deleted
body:
hi i noticed that after using xdrip "latest version" the history stored on the libre sensor seems be be getting deleted. when i scan using the libre app none of the last 8 hours is there.

unfortunately i need to keep the libre app up to date so if this is a feature can it be turned off somehow?

libre+blucon

comments.body: Not sure what you mean. Are you saying that reading that you had are getting deleted, or that the gap is not closed?

hiya,

i have to still scan my libre sensor for my clinic to view the graphs via libreview.

the libre sensor stores the last 8 hours of 15 min checks itself, but after using xdrip + blucon, when i go to update the libreview app the sensor hasnt got the last 8 hours. its treated like the sensor has no history stored at all.

it could just be a bug with the libre sensor? i thought it was a feature of xdrip heh...
I cannot confirm that for nightly 2018.06.10.

This seems very strange.
xDrip does not have a way to delete anything from the sensor.
ah, hmm do you think its just a issue with the libre? i stopped using xdrip and blucon just to see if the history started up again "same sensor" and its working fine
This is very strange, can you try putting the bluecon on and see if it happens again?
sure thing il report back in abit of testing :)

doesnt seem to be happening anymore strange! may have just been a bug with the sensor itself.

quick question, is there a way to get exactly the same values showing on xdrip as scanning with the libre app?
